description: BlobChunk with a non-empty octet run (`sequence<uint8, 65535> data`). The spec-side exercise of Appendix N.1's octet-run rule (finding 33): an octet run MUST project to a base64 string, not to a JSON array of integers. Before this vector the rule's only exercise was the web repo's authored BlobChunk; every vector here carried an empty or absent octet field, so a generator that had decided octet-ness on the wrong test would still have passed. The bytes are b'hello' = [104, 101, 108, 108, 111]; their base64 is "aGVsbG8=".
exercises: octet run (sequence<uint8,N>) projects to a base64 string per Appendix N.1, not a JSON array of integers
the base64 string round-trips CDR<->JSON byte-identically (five raw bytes <-> "aGVsbG8=")
a uint32 member (crc32) carries as a plain JSON number alongside the octet run
